$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: this app's override of the `orders::` strings, shorter for a phone screen; gen merges it key by key over the orders module's own lang files. Boundary: only keys the orders module defines, its derived keys included (`actions.order.cancel.confirm` is the cancel action's confirmation), the same keys in every locale (gen fails otherwise). Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0192, ADR 0234 d9 (string overrides live in `assets/overrides/<namespace>/`), ADR 0294 (decisions 20 and 23: an override swaps an asset file's strings by path)
